proposed_rows.role: closed PCNF quantified Boolean input
proposed_rows.notes: Prefix and matrix are both part of the input.

proposed_rows.role: fixed finite quantifier prefix
proposed_rows.notes: Immutable during proof checking; native source glyph retained.

proposed_rows.role: finite CNF matrix as clause set
proposed_rows.notes: The empty matrix is true.

proposed_rows.role: quantifier tag of block i
proposed_rows.notes: Existential or universal; no free matrix variables.

proposed_rows.role: finite disjoint variable block
proposed_rows.notes: Order inside an equal-quantifier block may be chosen for construction.

proposed_rows.role: Boolean variable
proposed_rows.notes: Indexed x_1 x_2 x_3 x_4 preserve source example names.

proposed_rows.role: signed Boolean literal
proposed_rows.notes: Complement flips signs without new double-negation formulas.

proposed_rows.role: complementary signed literal
proposed_rows.notes: An involution; source complement notation retained.

proposed_rows.role: empty literal-set clause
proposed_rows.notes: False under every complete valuation; not an empty CNF database.

proposed_rows.role: empty-clause false constant in this PCNF source
proposed_rows.notes: Not the undefined lifted value used by MiniSat in a separate chapter.

proposed_rows.role: prefix block level of a Boolean variable
proposed_rows.notes: Extends to signed literals through their underlying variable.

proposed_rows.role: quantifier tag of a prefix variable or literal
proposed_rows.notes: Arguments may be variables or signed literals at the same bound position.

proposed_rows.role: comparison of prefix block levels
proposed_rows.notes: Opposite quantifier types cannot share a block.

proposed_rows.role: underlying variable of a signed literal
proposed_rows.notes: Native preliminaries argument type.

proposed_rows.role: set of occurring matrix variables
proposed_rows.notes: Typed formula argument distinct from the single-literal argument.

proposed_rows.role: union of prefix variable blocks in the native rule guards
proposed_rows.notes: Source Fig.2.1 spelling retained rather than silently replacing it by var.

proposed_rows.role: existential Boolean variable
proposed_rows.notes: May depend only on earlier universal variables.

proposed_rows.role: universal Boolean variable
proposed_rows.notes: Its counterstrategy may depend only on earlier existentials.

proposed_rows.role: legal existential Skolem strategy function
proposed_rows.notes: Declared preceding-universal argument list; empty list is constant.

proposed_rows.role: legal universal Herbrand strategy function
proposed_rows.notes: Declared preceding-existential argument list.

proposed_rows.role: family of legal existential strategy functions
proposed_rows.notes: Clause satisfaction is required over every universal assignment.

proposed_rows.role: finite Boolean clause or rule conclusion
proposed_rows.notes: All accepted proof lines are non-tautological.

proposed_rows.role: clause remainder in a resolution parent
proposed_rows.notes: Printed decomposition guards retained; completeness chooses canonical removed-pivot remainder.

proposed_rows.role: clause remainder in the other resolution parent
proposed_rows.notes: Not a separate quantified matrix.

proposed_rows.role: existential pivot literal in common Q-Res
proposed_rows.notes: Universal-pivot variants have separate rules and are not credited here.

proposed_rows.role: derived clause in the native blocked-reduction example
proposed_rows.notes: Indices zero one two denote the actual source derivation.

proposed_rows.role: universal variable in the source example
proposed_rows.notes: Initially blocked by later x_2 and then reducible.

proposed_rows.role: positive-pivot parent remainder in innermost elimination
proposed_rows.notes: Canonical remainder contains neither pivot polarity.

proposed_rows.role: negative-pivot parent remainder in innermost elimination
proposed_rows.notes: Not the partial assignment called B in older chapters.

proposed_rows.role: outer existential variable in the alternating certificate
proposed_rows.notes: Cannot depend on later universal u.

proposed_rows.role: inner existential variable in the alternating certificate
proposed_rows.notes: Its elimination permits subsequent legal universal reductions.

proposed_rows.role: existential variable of the illegal-rule counterexample
proposed_rows.notes: Legal function y=x with prefix forall x exists y only.

proposed_rows.role: full trailing-universal reduction of a clause
proposed_rows.notes: 2013 full-reduction convention is separately defined and bridged.

proposed_rows.role: complete valuation of earlier variables in elimination proof
proposed_rows.notes: Quantifier-elimination equality is established for every such valuation. Root-authorized declaration/type reconciliation: Actual finite-domain valuation declaration now occurs in the PCNF definition BEFORE proof use; the raw earlier annex first-use remains historical evidence.

proposed_rows.role: universal-parent remainder in elimination proof
proposed_rows.notes: Contains neither polarity of the eliminated universal.
